messages.subject: Failed seed bombs
messages.text:
Hi there, Well these milkweed bombs were a huge failure. I would have thought that milkweed would be a sure thing, but after carefully planting them and nursing them since June, I have to finally accept that nothing is going to happen. I am just staring at some really nice dirt, that gets regular sun and water.
 

 I thought these would be full-proof, and I spent $35 on them. I would like to respectfully request a refund, especially since I will be going to the garden center to buy milkweed plants—I can get several for that price!!
 

 The link to My order is here, so you can confirm: https://lasclay.com/en-us/account/orders/2850f837db9a0f95a576bd236021853c
 

 Thank you for your prompt response.
 Karyn M Lowe 805/908-2313

messages.subject: Re: Failed seed bombs
messages.text:
Hi Karyn,
 

 We have received your message and are doing our utmost to respond and assist you as quickly as possible. It's a busy time for messages, and our customer service team is still quite small: just 1 full-time person and me, who helps out occasionally amidst my dozens of other tasks!
 

 Rest assured, however, that your situation will not be overlooked, and we will take care of it as soon as possible. It is understood that the return period applies from the time the customer notifies us of a desire to make an exchange or a refund, not from when we have time to respond. Serving our customers well is a high priority for us, even if we are sometimes a bit overwhelmed.
 

 In short, we haven't forgotten about you and we're working hard to not let you down!
